Claire H: Hey finance — I paid for catering at our DevSummit booth on my personal card. Vendor gave a single receipt for $1,240 but no VAT number or itemized line items. I need to submit for reimbursement and split 70/30 Marketing/Sales. Any guidance? /cc @Maya T
Samir R: Hi Claire — we usually need an itemized invoice + vendor tax ID to reclaim VAT. Can you attach the receipt here and confirm the vendor name/address?
Claire H: Attached receipt (IMG_20240303_1521.jpg). Vendor: LocalBites Catering Ltd, on-site POS printed total only. Vendor says they can’t print VAT ID on the handheld — they claim invoicing happens later via email.
Ethan P: I approve the 70/30 split for budget tracking. Claire, can you also list attendee names for the booth (for event spend policy)?
Claire H: Booth staff were: Claire H, Jordan L, Priya S. I asked vendor to email a proper invoice with VAT number; waiting reply.
Finance Bot: Reminder — company policy: expenses > $1,000 require a vendor invoice with tax registration number to reclaim VAT. If vendor cannot provide, finance can reimburse but VAT will be non-reclaimable.
Samir R: If vendor provides an emailed invoice within 48h, we can process reclaim. If not, we’ll reimburse gross and mark as `non-reclaimable VAT`. Use GL code `6401` (Marketing) and `6402` (Sales) when you submit in Concur.
Maya T: FYI marketing code is MARK-Q2; sales is SALES-Q2. I’ll add the PO reference once Claire uploads the invoice.
Claire H: Vendor just replied: "We can send an invoice but it will not include VAT ID — only name + address and total." I asked for VAT reg number specifically.
Samir R: Please forward that vendor reply into Concur along with the receipt. We’ll accept reimbursement but flag it. If you want us to push the vendor for a tax ID (for reclaim), say so and we’ll escalate with our vendor ops contact.
Claire H: Uploaded receipt + vendor reply to Concur and added the cost split (70/30). I’d prefer finance to escalate for VAT ID if possible.
Samir R: Received. We’ll try vendor ops escalation. If no VAT ID comes back, reimbursement timeline: 5-7 business days after manager approval.
Ethan P: Approved. Thanks Claire. :thumbsup:
Claire H: Thanks all — will track updates here.
